name: volothamp geddarm
lore:
Volothamp Geddarm is a species unto himself—a migratory raconteur typically found nesting in the smokiest corners of the Yawning Portal or wandering, uninvited, into the most perilous reaches of the Realms. His behavior is defined by a pathological curiosity and a staggering lack of self-preservation. He moves with the flamboyant confidence of a man who believes his own footnotes, perpetually clad in garish silks and topped with a signature floppy hat.

Volo’s "ecology" is parasitic yet strangely symbiotic; he thrives by extracting tales from weary adventurers in exchange for questionable advice. He possesses a supernatural knack for stumbling into cosmic horrors, yet survives through a combination of sheer luck and the hidden patronage of more sensible wizards. Approach with caution: to encounter Volo is to be drafted into a narrative where you are the expendable protagonist and he is the celebrated biographer.
